entries.desc: Truth source clearly separates Koala CLI, Runner CLI/Mac runner, and Python Authority responsibilities.
Docs explain that putting CLI and runner in one repo/package does not by itself make evidence authoritative.
Docs forbid claiming CLI local/shadow evidence or accepted-only POST responses as L2+ production authority receipts.
Authority envelope or submission decision exposes a local/shadow/thin-client classification that downstream code/tests can assert.
Enforce transport success based only on accepted=true is not described or typed as verified server receipt authority.
A smoke test proves missing producerRunId/verifierRunId/provider/model/vendor/hash/receipt fields cannot be upgraded to a production L2+ claim.
Local/off mode remains usable and clearly classified as local evidence.
Shadow/enforce transport failures keep existing behavior but warning/error text does not overclaim receipt-backed authority.
A forged/local-only authority success path cannot pass a smoke assertion that requires server receipt-backed authority.
Focused authority/client smoke tests pass and prove the boundary classification.
The story output explicitly says Runner CLI/Mac and Python authority work are separate follow-up stories.
Reviewer can verify no files outside CLI Milestone 1 scope were modified and no external repo was changed.
